scope_notes: Logical unsharded shapes: actual TP rank-local tensors have shard dimensions; expert parallel shards contain subsets of experts.

Architecture parameter count excludes quantization scales and nontrainable token-ID routing tables. Gate correction bias is included because it is a declared model parameter; not claiming ordinary gradient optimization for it.
Root embeds and output weights are untied; MTP shares their storage with root.
Sampled shard headers cover root, HCA+hash, CSA+hash and complete MTP. Remaining layer shapes derived from verified constructors; complete names reconcile against all 145116 index entries.
Source inference code converts wo_a to BF16 and norms/compressors to FP32 for convenience; published checkpoint dtypes, not runtime casts, are recorded here.

Published index total_size counts actual packed data bytes and scales; it excludes safetensors file headers.
